rules.description: Every outbound HTTP request must have a timeout (AbortSignal or timeout option)
Secret headers must be declared in secretHeaders[] and redacted in all log statements
Retry policy must declare allowedMethods or allowedStatuses — no retry-on-all
Base URLs must come from config, not hardcoded string literals
Non-2xx responses must be normalized into typed error classes
Retry must never apply to 4xx client errors (400-499)
